Name: Afrikaans Translation
Author: twv2un
Description:
[size=5][b]Afrikaans[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Wat dit doen[/b][/size]
Voeg [b]Afrikaans[/b] as taal by die speletjie by. Klik op die titelskerm op die wêreldbol-knoppie, kies Afrikaans, en Pelican Town praat Afrikaans.

[size=4][b]Wat vertaal is[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Elke gesprek, elke gebeurtenis en elke fees[/*]
[*]Briewe, items, take, kieslyste en die res van die skerm[/*]
[*]99 borde, plakkate en titelprente, met die hand in Afrikaans oorgeteken[/*]
[*]Werk met nuwe en bestaande plase (met 'n nuwe plaas sien jy alles van dag een af)[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Installasie[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Installeer [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url] en [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].[/*]
[*]Pak hierdie mod uit en sit [i][CP] Stardew Valley Afrikaans[/i] in jou Mods-vouer.[/*]
[*]Maak die speletjie deur SMAPI oop en kies Afrikaans by die wêreldbol-knoppie.[/*]
[/list]'n Geïllustreerde gids in Afrikaans vir Windows en Mac is ingesluit (LEES MY EERS.pdf).

[size=4][b]Versoenbaarheid[/b][/size]
Stardew Valley 1.6+, SMAPI 4.0+, Content Patcher 2.9+. Teks van ander mods bly in hul eie taal, tensy hulle self 'n Afrikaanse vertaling het.

[size=4][b]Bekende probleme[/b][/size]
Nog nie op elke platform getoets nie. Sien jy 'n tikfout, 'n vreemde sin of teks wat nog Engels is? Laat weet asseblief in die Bugs-oortjie.

[size=4][b]'n Klein opdrag[/b][/size]
'n Paar borde en sinne knik na twee Afrikaanse musiekprojekte van Stellenbosch wie se werk ek baie geniet: [url=https://www.instagram.com/dierbaar_band/]Dierbaar[/url] en [url=https://www.instagram.com/jantjiekrog/]Jantjie Krog[/url]. Hou 'n oog op die plakkaat by Sam se vertoning, en op Joja se uiters toegewyde moedermaatskappy. Gaan luister gerus na hulle.

[line]

[size=5][b]English[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]What it does[/b][/size]
Adds [b]Afrikaans[/b] as a language option. Click the globe button on the title screen, choose Afrikaans, and Pelican Town speaks Afrikaans.

[size=4][b]Key features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Every line of dialogue, every event and every festival translated[/*]
[*]Mail, items, quests, menus and the rest of the interface[/*]
[*]99 signs, posters and pieces of title art redrawn by hand in Afrikaans[/*]
[*]Works with new and existing saves (a new farm shows everything from day one)[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].[/*]
[*]Unzip this mod and drop [i][CP] Stardew Valley Afrikaans[/i] into your Mods folder.[/*]
[*]Start the game through SMAPI and pick Afrikaans with the globe button.[/*]
[/list]An illustrated step-by-step guide in Afrikaans for Windows and Mac is included (LEES MY EERS.pdf).

[size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
Stardew Valley 1.6+, SMAPI 4.0+, Content Patcher 2.9+. Text from other mods stays in their own language unless they ship an Afrikaans translation.

[size=4][b]Known issues[/b][/size]
Not yet tested on every platform. Please report typos, odd phrasing or text that's still in English in the Bugs tab.

[size=4][b]A small dedication[/b][/size]
A few signs and lines nod to two Afrikaans music projects from Stellenbosch whose work I'm quite fond of: [url=https://www.instagram.com/dierbaar_band/]Dierbaar[/url] and [url=https://www.instagram.com/jantjiekrog/]Jantjie Krog[/url]. Look out for the poster at Sam's show and for Joja's rather devout parent company. Go give them a listen.

Source and issues: [url=https://github.com/calerio/stardew-valley-afrikaans]GitHub[/url]
